plan.notes: Source: official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog (PDF), Department of Biological Sciences, Suggested Plan of Study for BS Biology: Pre-Health Biology, plan lines 21182-21280. The plan's printed totals are 16 / 14 / 15 / 14-15 / 15 / 15 / 16 / 14-15 with a printed program total of 120. Sequenced credit sum using the lower bounds of the two printed ranges (3 for BIOL 2073/2071 in semester 4, 2 for the semester 8 Elective) = 119, one credit below the printed 120. The gap is honestly recorded: with the maximum of each range the sum is 121. Pre-Health Electives per the plan: BIOL 3143/3141 Comparative Vertebrate Anatomy/Lab, BIOL 4033/4031 Developmental Biology/Lab, BIOL 3373/3371 Introduction to Neuroscience/Lab, BIOL 4043/4041 Immunology/Lab, BIOL 3411-3414 Internship in Biology, BIOL 4243 Viral Genetics, BIOL 3583 Biostatistics, BIOL 4244 Advanced Microscopy and Histology, BIOL 3703/3701 Vertebrate Physiology/Lab, BIOL 4891 Independent Research in Biology.
